description: Campaign level 30 is completable: the hard opponent bot for the player sends its settlers home at the start (they cannot wake the sunk Hearth), marches the Shaper to the gate stones ahead of the pursuers (only then does the Hearth rise, with its three keepers), gains twenty four followers, cuts down eighteen pursuers from the two bands and the 60 s raids, breaks the sixteen keepers at the Oath Stone and prays there with four, then holds the Oath Stone and the woken road ley together for 210 s after the beach pursuers pray the ley away once and it takes it back (bot wins at 24084; stages at about 2000, 11000, 13750 and 16750).
